text:
Mira: Heads-up: seeing gradual memory creep on long-context perf tests (200k+ tokens). KV resident set increases over sessions, but eviction_total is low. Repro attached.

Sohail: Which workload? prod-like replay or synthetic?

Mira: prod-replay. Small snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:01:02Z rss=42G kv_paged_bytes=11.2G kv_residency=0.31 eviction_total=34
2026-03-17T12:06:02Z rss=44G kv_paged_bytes=13.1G kv_residency=0.29 eviction_total=36
```

Alex: Hmm. Looks like pages are accumulating but evictions aren't keeping up. I'd like more attribution: evictions_by_age_bucket + evictions_by_reason (e.g. size_threshold, stale, manual). Proposed PromQLs:
```
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (reason)
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(kv_residency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

InfraBot: deploy/pipeline:metrics-counters-eviction-attrs started by @Emily (CI link: https://ci.redwood/incremental/789)

Chandra: Cost/overhead for these counters? cardinality explosion worry.

Alex: We can keep labels tight: reason in {age,size,stale,manual,oom}. Sampling only for fragmentation ratios. Expected ~1-2% CPU for hot paths, <0.5% mem.

Mira: Nice. Also would like fragmentation metric: kv_fragmented_bytes / kv_allocated_bytes. Could help explain why residency drops while rss climbs.

Emily: I'll open a quick PR to add counters + docs. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4523 — implements kv_evictions_total{reason}, kv_fragmentation_ratio, kv_residency_histogram, and exports a sampled eviction_trace log.

Sohail: Suggest alerts:
- kv_residency_p90 < 0.5 for 10m
- rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]) > 1000 and eviction by reason=oom
- kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.2

Mira: I'll attach the long-run profile once counters are in. Thanks :eyes:

Emily: PR merged to canary, rolling out now. Ping if you see perf regression. :thumbsup:

InfraBot: canary deploy succeeded (canary-42) :party_parrot:
